name: tactical-units
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for a 320x200 tactical game. Original premium 1994 PC pixel art inspired by X-COM UFO Defense, with XCOM 2 armor and alien technology. Genuine transparent background. Keep every sprite fully inside its equal cell, generous clear margin, no shadows outside cell. Landscape canvas 1280x1152, exact 5 columns by 3 rows, equal 256x384 cells. Each cell contains one small sprite designed to downsample to 16x24. Exactly fifteen sprites, five for each race. Do not draw large portraits.
